scientific_integrity: Exact fixed-object integral homology certified by independent face enumerations, two complete acyclic Morse matchings, unit integer reductions and direct prime-field boundary checks. No external independent audit or generalization is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Does not determine homotopy type, higher operations, equivariant representations, or arbitrary cube dimensions. Top-rank component is consistent with known general Hamiltonian-cycle results; distinctive information is complete lower-degree integral homology. Novelty depends on inspected sources and records, not an exhaustive bibliography.
title: Integral multipath homology of the bidirected three-cube
